title: GitHub App server-to-server token, GitHub Classic personal access token and 1 more: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic GitHub App server-to-server token, GitHub Classic personal access token and 1 more values built to the documented format appear in 4 inputs in command lines, structured files (JSON, YAML, TOML), command and tool output, and URLs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
